description: Compost applied at a rate of 17 Mg ha⁻¹ before the tomato season.
Mustard cover crop (MCC) planted on 3 Nov 2005 with three planting lines per bed.
Laser leveling of the entire 0.8‑ha field during summer/fall 2005.
Mowing of the mustard cover crop on 26 Apr 2006.
Light incorporation of mustard residues into the top 10 cm of soil after 19 days.
Mechanical weeding/cultivation performed during the tomato growing season.
Manual weeding performed during the tomato growing season.
Sulfur applied as a mite and disease preventive measure during the tomato season.
Nine furrow irrigation events spaced ≈11 days apart, each delivering 88 ± 22 mm.
Winter fallow treatment (no cover crop) applied to half of the main plots.
Winter mustard cover crop (MCC) treatment applied to the other half of the main plots.
